status: Round 7: 144 packs across 9 themes, a Music tab with your picks and 22 researched tracks or packs.

packs.name: Neorice Pixelart Mushroom Pack
packs.size: Mixed sprite sizes; 16x16 versions of most mushrooms in progress
packs.notes: Side view, soft coloured outlines, few shades per cap: the closest look to our shroom stamps. Over 100 species with 4 to 8 variants each, plus 7 mosses and lichens for walls. Warm, autumn palette by default, so it needs a palette swap to our sage greens. Pack is still in development. Same artist sells a Flower pack ($15) in the same style.
packs.commission: Takes requests for new pieces in a pack (comments, Bluesky, Discord @Neoriceisgood); Ko-fi linked. No formal commission sheet seen.

scale.caption: Same zoom (3x): our cluster, tall shroom and small cap on the left, Neorice native 1x previews on the right. The caps are about our size, and the pale blue-white group in the third panel is close to our clusters.

packs.name: LockVenture #1: Cave
packs.notes: Side-view cave at our density with coloured outlines and hanging vines. Mushrooms are red toadstools, the palette is warm brick and green. Few flora pieces; it is mostly rooms and props.
packs.commission: No. The studio said in the comments that it does not take commissions.

packs.name: Mycelium
packs.notes: Bioluminescent underworld with emission maps for glow. Tall thin glowing stalks are close to our tall shrooms in shape. Glow-cyan look and 8x8 density are smaller and colder than ours.

packs.name: Pixel art Mushroom Caves
packs.notes: Side-view metroidvania cave, but blue and crimson with dark outlines, and a 32x32 grid, so props are twice our density.

packs.name: Mossy Cavern
packs.license: Commercial OK, credit optional, no resale
packs.notes: The mood is right: dark teal cave, mossy and glowing. But it is painted at high resolution, so it cannot sit on our 2 px cell grid without redrawing.
packs.commission: Asked in comments, no public answer

packs.name: Shroom Cave Asset Pack
packs.notes: Top-down RPG view in purple. The glowing shrooms are nice, but the view is wrong for side-on placement.

packs.name: 16x16 RPG Cave Tiles
packs.license: Commercial OK, no AI training, no NFTs
packs.notes: Covers our list on paper, but it is a top-down RPG set.

packs.name: Cave Dwellers
packs.notes: Right view and density, wrong world: a red rock mine with torches and carts, almost no flora.

packs.name: Slinking Skinks
packs.notes: The only gecko pack found so far. Top-down and rough; nowhere near our 42 px side-view gecko.

packs.name: The Seeker: Moss Grotto
packs.notes: The closest palette found: flat sage, olive and grey-green on near-black, no outlines, few shades. No mushrooms or vines. The game repo says some sprites come from Python tools, so check how hand-made it is. A Fauna pack adds two plant creatures. At the same zoom its pixels are about half the size of ours (6x6 tiles), so it reads finer-grained.

scale.caption: Same zoom (3x): our cluster, tall shroom, small cap, fern and white moss on the left; the pack brought down to its native 1x on the right. Its plants come out at about half our size: the palette is right but the grain is finer than our cells.

packs.name: Fantasy Caves
packs.license: Commercial OK, no credit needed, no resale
packs.notes: Polished hi-bit cave with pale sage mushrooms (a tall thin one like ours), hanging vines and leafy sprouts. More shades than our sprites; purple-brown rock would need a recolour. Also a strong fantasy-cave mood.
packs.commission: Has declined in itch comments ("too busy"). X @Namatnieks.

scale.caption: Same zoom (3x): our cluster, tall shroom, small cap, fern and white moss on the left; the pack brought down to its native 1x on the right. The pale mushroom and the hanging moss sit at our size. This is the right density.

packs.name: A Lot of Mushrooms
packs.license: Commercial OK, no credit needed, no resale
packs.notes: 235 side-view mushrooms in 23 colour schemes, including teal and white-cream. Darker outlines, 3 to 4 shades. The nearest thing to a ready-made replacement for every shroom stamp.
packs.commission: Not now: "unable to work on individual projects". sanctumpixel@gmail.com

packs.name: Alien Worlds: Overgrown Cave
packs.license: Commercial OK, credit required, no resale
packs.notes: Flat olive, teal and khaki on near-black, no outlines, 3 to 4 shades. Art from his game Jetscout. Few mushrooms. A sister pack, Mossy Cave, is greener.
packs.commission: None advertised. Contact page at okshur.com, X @dustinaux.

packs.name: Alien Worlds: Mossy Cave
packs.notes: Same flat, no-outline style as Overgrown Cave, greener with brown rock. Includes a bonus recolour.

packs.name: Cavelands (Mushroom Caves)
packs.license: Commercial OK, credit required, no resale
packs.notes: Pale mint mushrooms and pale moss are close to our colours; the rock is pinkish-brown on navy. Outlines are a darker shade of each colour. A crystal version adds lavender clusters in floors, walls and ceilings on muted mauve rock.

packs.name: Flowers (78 plants)
packs.notes: Free and at our exact scale, no outlines, 2 to 3 shades. Bright DB32 palette, so it needs a recolour to sage.

scale.caption: Same zoom (3x): our cluster, tall shroom, small cap, fern and white moss on the left; the pack brought down to its native 1x on the right. Plants come out 10 to 24 px, the same size as ours.

packs.name: Climbing Plants Pack
packs.license: Commercial OK, edits OK, no redistribution
packs.notes: Flat, no outlines, 2 to 3 greens; includes willow-like hanging leaves and a pale blue-white vine.

packs.name: Morbifungi
packs.license: Commercial OK, no credit, no AI training
packs.notes: 8 bright mushrooms with separate glow layers. Too saturated and large for drop-in use, but a good reference for how glow could be drawn.

packs.name: Cute Caves
packs.notes: Navy cave with dark-outlined cobbles; only the vines are close.

packs.name: Super Grotto Escape
packs.notes: Saturated SNES blues and purples with heavy shading. Only the ferns are of use.

packs.name: Pixel Art Boss: Gecko
packs.license: Commercial OK, no credit, no resale
packs.notes: Side-view leopard gecko with idle, walk, attack and death. Black outline, cream and orange, bigger than ours. Only useful as reference, since our gecko is drawn by code.

packs.name: Lizard Enemy
packs.notes: Chunky green lizard with dark outlines, close to our gecko in size. Reference only.

packs.name: Dark Platformer Complete
packs.license: Commercial OK, no credit needed, no resale
packs.notes: The closest to the Rain World mood: ruined megastructures, dim teal glyph-lights, fog layers. 32 px tiles make the halls read huge next to a 42 px gecko, which suits a mine built by something bigger. Animated fan, elevator and switch could become the machines that still run.
packs.commission: None stated. Discord (linked from the itch profile).

scale.caption: Same zoom (3x): our sprites on the left, the pack at its native pixels on the right (middle crop). Fine grain, close to ours; the structures are just big.

packs.name: Sci-fi Static Caves
packs.license: Commercial OK, credit optional, no resale
packs.notes: Near-black teal cave with a strange glowing tree and drifting motes. Strange, melancholy and quiet, at our density. Small pack: a mood piece more than a full set.
packs.commission: Patreon lists a digital commission reward; status not stated. Discord, X @penusbmic.

scale.caption: Same zoom (3x): our sprites on the left, the pack at its native pixels on the right (middle crop). Our grain, slightly chunkier.

packs.name: Metroidvania Biomes 4500+
packs.license: Not stated on the page; ask
packs.notes: Copper ruins and small glowing plants on near-black navy: the nearest thing to ash caves lit by copper veins. 9 sub-biomes; the underwater station parts fit flooded machinery. The artist openly takes commissions, so this is the best lead for a custom set.
packs.commission: Open for commissions (itch profile). samvieten.com, X @samvieten.

scale.caption: Same zoom (3x): our sprites on the left, the pack at its native pixels on the right (middle crop). Right at our grain.

packs.name: Pixel Fantasy Caves
packs.notes: Free, rated 4.9 from 132 ratings. Flooded caves with mine supports and ruin columns, close to the GDD's flooded shafts. Timber and brick are a bit human-made for the never-shown makers.

packs.name: Fantasy Pack: Deep Cave
packs.notes: The best mine prop kit at our density: scaffolds, chains, lanterns, crystals. Slate cave reads dark; pink crystals and the human-sized doors and chests would need trimming or a recolour.

scale.caption: Same zoom (3x): our sprites on the left, the pack at its native pixels on the right (middle crop). Our grain.

packs.name: The DARK Series: Ancient Caves
packs.license: Commercial OK, credit optional, no resale
packs.notes: Near-black cave, flat yellow-green moss drips (1 to 3 px, close to our hanging leaves), pipes that connect, animated smoke and giant relic silhouettes. The relics are swords and spears, which clash with the GDD rule of no tools sized for hands. Green, autumn and purple variants.

scale.caption: Same zoom (3x): our cluster, tall shroom, small cap, fern and white moss on the left; the pack brought down to its native 1x on the right. The moss drips and grass tufts are at our grain.

packs.name: Red Gothic Factory
packs.license: Commercial OK, no credit needed, no resale
packs.notes: Smelter halls with molten metal. Hot, not cold; a recolour to dead greys and embers would make the GDD's cold smelters. Gothic arches lean human.

scale.caption: Same zoom (3x): our sprites on the left, the pack at its native pixels on the right (middle crop). Coarse blocks at our grain.

packs.name: Parallax Backgrounds: Caves
packs.license: Commercial OK, no credit, no AI training
packs.notes: Moody grey-violet stalactite background in 7 layers. Fits black ash caves behind the particle world.

packs.name: The DARK Series: Parallax Background
packs.notes: Very sombre greyscale cave with light shafts. A good far layer.

packs.name: Cave critters (6 small packs)
packs.notes: Cute-first critters at gecko scale. The dung beetle rolling a ball could be the ore hauler; the small slime splits from a bigger one, like our merging blobs. Outlined and brighter than the caves above.
packs.commission: Patreon has commission tiers (custom medium and big characters).

packs.name: Squishy Slug
packs.notes: Cute big-eyed slug; recolour pale for the glow slugs.

packs.name: Old Pipes
packs.notes: Pipe runs and grates for pump rooms, in copper or iron. The carved stone faces break the no-makers-shown rule; leave them out.

packs.name: 16x16 Industrial
packs.notes: Minimal dark-blue girders and lattices: a clean frame for derelict halls.

packs.name: Abandoned Outpost
packs.license: Commercial OK, no AI use, credit appreciated
packs.notes: Derelict sci-fi facility; doors, rails and consoles are human-scaled.
packs.commission: Contact by email on the page. X @schwarnhild.

packs.name: Mine Tileset
packs.license: Commercial OK, credit with link required
packs.notes: Bright and busy; useful for ore-vein parts, not the mood.

packs.name: Pixel Art Stylized Background
packs.notes: Not caves, but the blue fog sets could be vistas for a great shaft.

packs.name: Gothicvania Power Crystals
packs.notes: Glowing crystal and ore props; saturated.
packs.commission: No ("No I dont" on another page).

packs.name: Crystal Cave Platformer Tileset
packs.license: Commercial OK, no credit needed, no redistribution
covers: crystals on floor, wall and ceiling
packs.notes: Grey layered stone on a dark purple cave, crystals in few tones that recolour easily. Grows in all three orientations. The moodiest crystal set found.

packs.name: Free Crystals Pack
packs.size: 8 types x 5 sizes, about 5 to 75 px
packs.notes: Floor clusters in five sizes each. The orange and yellow ones are the GDD's copper and sulphur almost as they stand. Clean outlines, flat shading. No glow or animation.
packs.commission: A studio, not an artist for hire.

packs.name: Crystal Caverns
packs.license: Commercial OK, no credit needed, no resale
packs.notes: Glowing crystal variants and separate glow orbs that act as light sources. Magenta on purple with dithering: brighter than the brief, needs a recolour.

scale.caption: Same zoom (3x): our sprites on the left, the pack at its native pixels on the right. Slightly coarser than ours (24 px tiles).

packs.name: Crystal World Platformer Set
packs.license: Commercial OK, no credit needed, no resale
packs.notes: Chunky teal and lavender crystal spikes on walls and ceilings. The peach background would need a darker palette.

packs.name: Crystal Cave
packs.notes: Teal ice crystals on dark navy: the GDD's pale ice. Rated 2/5 on the page.

packs.name: Pixel Crystal Cave Tileset
packs.license: Commercial OK, no resale, no NFT or generative-AI use
covers: growths on floor, ceiling and wall
packs.notes: Best all-orientation coverage, but rainbow candy crystals on pale blue rock. Recolour the crystals and darken the rock.

scale.caption: Same zoom (3x): our sprites on the left, the pack at its native pixels on the right. 32 px tiles, but the crystals sit at our grain.

packs.name: Crystal Mine Tile Set
packs.notes: Very dark rock with magenta clusters. Mood fits; recolour the crystals. Small pack.

scale.caption: Same zoom (3x): our sprites on the left, the pack at its native pixels on the right. Our grain.

packs.name: Pixel Crystal Animation
packs.license: Commercial OK, may modify, no resale
packs.notes: Animated shimmer on a single floating crystal. A pickup or a waking lamp rather than a growth.

scale.caption: Same zoom (3x): our sprites on the left, the pack at its native pixels on the right. Our grain; each crystal is about 48 px tall.

packs.name: Green, Blue and Purple Crystals
packs.notes: Thick outlines, few colours: very easy to recolour. Cute and chunky. Three separate packs (green, blue, purple).

scale.caption: Same zoom (3x): our sprites on the left, the pack at its native pixels on the right. Our size.

packs.name: Crystals
packs.license: Commercial OK, no credit needed, no resale
covers: upright, diagonal and shard crystals in 4 colours
packs.notes: Small set with diagonal crystals that suit wall growth. Aseprite files.

scale.caption: Same zoom (3x): our sprites on the left, the pack at its native pixels on the right. Our grain.

packs.name: Caves and Mines Tileset
packs.license: Commercial OK, no credit needed, no redistribution
covers: 12 ore types as veins in stone
packs.notes: The only real ore veins inside wall tiles (Terraria style). Flat and simple; a base to repaint copper veins from.

packs.name: Stones and Ore/Gem Veins 16x16
covers: ore lumps: copper, iron, gold, coal, gems
packs.notes: Grey rock lumps with coloured flecks, 5 shapes per ore. Standalone ore nodes rather than wall veins.

scale.caption: Same zoom (3x): our sprites on the left, the pack at its native pixels on the right. Our grain.

packs.name: OPP2017 Cave and Mine Cart
packs.artist: Hapiel and the Open Pixel Project
packs.notes: Dark navy cave with blue crystals, but 32x32 and cartoony.

packs.name: Crystal Cave Platformer Tileset
packs.license: Commercial OK, no credit needed, no resale
covers: purple, blue and yellow floor crystals
packs.notes: Soft navy cave, crystals as small accents. Cosy rather than eerie.

packs.name: Animated Pixel Slimes in NES Colors
packs.license: No license text on the page; ask
packs.notes: The best match for translucent slimes: every slime comes semi-transparent as well as opaque. The demo shows one slime over another, which reads like a merge. Cute, pale cyan, pink and green.

scale.caption: Same zoom (3x): our gecko and small cap on the left, the pack at its native pixels on the right. Slimes a bit smaller than half the gecko.

packs.name: Giant Slime
packs.size: 64x96 slices, big body about 45x25, splits into about 10 px slimes
packs.notes: Pale sky-blue slime as big as the gecko that splits into small ones: the closest thing to our merge and split. Dark outline, dopey face, side view.

scale.caption: Same zoom (3x): our gecko and small cap on the left, the pack at its native pixels on the right. A big slime the size of the gecko.

packs.name: x4 Animated Grass Slimes
packs.license: Commercial OK and modify OK per profile; no redistribution unless modified
packs.notes: Pale washed green, softly see-through where blobs overlap; the cover heap looks like a merged colony. Front-facing. The artist openly takes commissions.

scale.caption: Same zoom (3x): our gecko and small cap on the left, the pack at its native pixels on the right. A heap of overlapping blobs.

packs.name: 2D Pixel Slime Set
packs.license: Commercial OK, modify OK, no redistribution
packs.notes: Tiny soft slimes with a swallow animation, our engulf-and-drag, and a death that melts into a puddle. Grey version recolours easily.

scale.caption: Same zoom (3x): our gecko and small cap on the left, the pack at its native pixels on the right. Tiny: about a quarter of the gecko.

packs.name: Dungeon Mobs Slime
packs.license: Commercial OK, credit optional, no resale
packs.size: Small bodies about 14x9, plus a giant boss
packs.notes: Glossy jelly with a dark outline, mostly opaque. The pop into three droplets that turn to bubble rings works as a splatter.

scale.caption: Same zoom (3x): our gecko and small cap on the left, the pack at its native pixels on the right. Title card at native size.

packs.name: Slime Pack 32x32
packs.license: No license stated; ask before use
packs.notes: Pale mint with a light rim and darker core that reads as jelly. The big open mouth is a reference for eat or absorb.

scale.caption: Same zoom (3x): our gecko and small cap on the left, the pack at its native pixels on the right. Native 1x frame.

packs.name: Free Platformer Slimes
packs.size: 16x16 and 32x32 sheets, bodies about 8 to 10 px
packs.notes: Tiny pastel slimes with soft or hard outlines.

packs.name: The World of Slimes
packs.license: CC BY-SA 4.0 (share-alike: a catch for a commercial game)
packs.notes: Very cute swirly slimes with eating and sleeping animations. The share-alike license makes it reference only.

scale.caption: Same zoom (3x): our gecko and small cap on the left, the pack at its native pixels on the right. Blue slimes at about half the gecko.

packs.name: Pixel Art Slime
packs.license: Commercial OK, credit optional, no resale
packs.notes: Muted teal, cute, side view. The artist is a freelance illustrator.

scale.caption: Same zoom (3x): our gecko and small cap on the left, the pack at its native pixels on the right. Native size.

packs.name: Mini Ooze Cube
packs.notes: Pale ice-blue gel wedge with a faint face; pale more than see-through.

scale.caption: Same zoom (3x): our gecko and small cap on the left, the pack at its native pixels on the right. Native size.

packs.name: Minimalist Cave Tileset & Slime
packs.notes: A mood reference: dark indigo cave with a tiny pale slime, close to the melancholy brief.

scale.caption: Same zoom (3x): our gecko and small cap on the left, the pack at its native pixels on the right. Our grain.

packs.name: Orange Slime / Ooze Monster Pack
packs.size: Big Grub, Small Ooze Grub, Fly Grub, Ooze Momma
covers: idle, walk, jump, fall, hit, death
packs.notes: The "weird second" option: drooping, oozing grubs. Tagged Creepy, Dark, Gore; check the Corpse sprite against the no-gore rule.

scale.caption: Same zoom (3x): our gecko and small cap on the left, the pack at its native pixels on the right. Ooze grub at native size.

packs.name: Free Slime Sprite Sheets
covers: translucent shell with an inner nucleus
idle, walk, run, jump, hurt, dead
packs.notes: Too big to use, but the translucent shell around a visible core is a strong reference for a metaball slime with a nucleus.

packs.name: Enemy Pack: Slug, Plant & Wasp
packs.notes: A shadowy, Rain World-ish slug.

scale.caption: Same zoom (3x): our gecko and small cap on the left, the pack at its native pixels on the right. A tall shadow slug next to the gecko.

packs.name: Micro Mobs: Underground
covers: worm: idle, walk, attack, dig, hide, appear, hit
packs.notes: A worm that digs, hides and reappears: a creature that lives in chewable rock. The artist takes paid freelance work.

scale.caption: Same zoom (3x): our gecko and small cap on the left, the pack at its native pixels on the right. Native size.

packs.name: Jellyfish
covers: idle, move, damage, death, washed ashore
packs.notes: Pale pink drifting blobs: a reference for floating or glowing slime.

scale.caption: Same zoom (3x): our gecko and small cap on the left, the pack at its native pixels on the right. Small drifters.

packs.name: Worm Sprite
packs.notes: Pale cream maggot, cute and weird: a model for a glow grub.

scale.caption: Same zoom (3x): our gecko and small cap on the left, the pack at its native pixels on the right. Native size, close to the gecko.

packs.name: Snail 18x16
covers: walk, hide, unhide, alarmed, jump, death
packs.notes: Cute surface crawler with hide and alarmed animations.

packs.name: 1-Bit Underground Cave Backgrounds
packs.notes: Dithered black-and-grey stalactite rows over pure black: the closest thing to black volcanic ash. Recolour the light tone toward copper. Slightly finer than our 480x270 screen.

packs.name: Cave + Flooded Cave Parallax
packs.license: No license text; ask before use
packs.notes: Very dark teal-black rock masses, moody and muted. The flooded set has a still water floor: the GDD's flooded shafts. Right density. A plain cave version is at rengodev.itch.io/cave-p.

scale.caption: Same zoom (3x): our gecko and shroom cluster on the left, the background at its native pixels on the right (middle crop). Our grain.

packs.name: Cave Background
packs.size: 4 layers, 320x180, pans on x and y
covers: copper and rust rims on near-black
packs.notes: Jagged rock rims in peach, copper and rust on near-black: already dark rock edged with copper light. Pans vertically, which matters for a vertical climb. 320x180 is a bit coarse; tile it.

scale.caption: Same zoom (3x): our gecko and shroom cluster on the left, the background at its native pixels on the right (middle crop). Slightly coarser than ours.

packs.name: Cavernous Background
packs.notes: Dark navy cavern with textured stalactite masses. Fits as is. Probably a flat image, not layers.

scale.caption: Same zoom (3x): our gecko and shroom cluster on the left, the background at its native pixels on the right (middle crop). Our grain.

packs.name: Cave Background
packs.license: Commercial OK, modify OK, no resale
packs.size: 6 layers, 640x360 files drawn on a 320x180 grid
packs.notes: Muted dusty stalactite rows, dark. Published ten days ago. The same artist's Foggy Ruins has angel statues (human figures), so skip that one.

scale.caption: Same zoom (3x): our gecko and shroom cluster on the left, the background at its native pixels on the right (middle crop). Drawn at 2x: coarser than ours.

packs.name: Pixel Art Cave Background
packs.license: Commercial OK, no credit, no redistribution
packs.notes: Plain flat silhouette bands, very easy to recolour into ash black: a good fog and depth base. Only 250 tall; extend upward.

scale.caption: Same zoom (3x): our gecko and shroom cluster on the left, the background at its native pixels on the right (middle crop). Our grain.

packs.name: Unique Cave Parallax Landscapes
packs.license: Commercial OK, credit requested, no AI use
covers: crystal, ruins, mushroom, misty, lava caves
packs.notes: Rich hand-made art but bright and saturated; needs a heavy palette swap. Skip the Bones biome. Commissions are open.

packs.name: Parallax Red Cave
packs.license: Tagged royalty free; no license text
packs.notes: Pure flat-colour silhouette layers in reds: as a hazy depth stack, perfect to recolour to grey and black with copper accents.

scale.caption: Same zoom (3x): our gecko and shroom cluster on the left, the background at its native pixels on the right (middle crop). Flat shapes, about our grain.

packs.name: Cave Environment
packs.notes: Limbo and Inside mood, light shafts and haze: the best mood here, but painterly and far finer than our grain. Reference or a far fog layer only.

packs.name: Background Ruined Temple
packs.license: Commercial OK, no credit needed, no resale
covers: dark pillars framing a lit hazy void
packs.notes: The closest to the window idea: dark stone pillars frame openings onto a bright, hazy void with silhouetted ruins. Built masonry rather than machinery, and the haze is warm; recolour to cold smoky copper.

scale.caption: Same zoom (3x): our gecko and shroom cluster on the left, the background at its native pixels on the right (middle crop). Pillar and haze at native pixels.

packs.name: Industrial Parallax Background
packs.notes: Night silhouettes of scaffolds, gantries, tanks and pipes with a few lamps: a derelict-machinery skyline once recoloured. Short; extend vertically. Lit windows need painting out.

scale.caption: Same zoom (3x): our gecko and shroom cluster on the left, the background at its native pixels on the right (middle crop). Coarse 2x at our zoom.

packs.name: Bulkhead Walls Environment
packs.size: Layered PSD and PNG plus tiles
packs.notes: A near-black hangar with a huge girder gantry and hanging cables in dark teal: girders, gantries and chains as a mid layer seen through a window.

scale.caption: Same zoom (3x): our gecko and shroom cluster on the left, the background at its native pixels on the right (middle crop). Girders and cables at our grain.

packs.name: The DARK Series: Parallax Backgrounds
packs.notes: Huge gear silhouettes fading into pale haze: the best giant-machinery-in-haze layer found. The gears carry engraved runes, which break the no-writing rule; paint them out. The hanging cages could be crane hooks.

packs.name: Industrial Zone Backgrounds
packs.notes: Grey hazy plant silhouettes, muted and dark, right density. The smoke implies outdoors; paint the plumes out.

packs.name: Dark Green Industrial Zone
packs.notes: Dark green silhouettes with a crane and fog band. A recolour candidate.

packs.name: Sci-Fi Parallax Backgrounds
packs.notes: Dark indigo interiors with a tall vertical shaft of stacked machinery decks: a great shaft seen through a window, and one of only two picks built for vertical scrolling.

scale.caption: Same zoom (3x): our gecko and shroom cluster on the left, the background at its native pixels on the right (middle crop). Our grain.

packs.name: Lost City 5-Layer
packs.notes: Dark grey hazy megastructure stacks with almost no light; reads as a city unless the tops are cropped.

packs.name: Post-apocalyptic Background
packs.license: Commercial OK, no credit, no redistribution
packs.notes: Exactly our width; a good example of graded haze layers to recolour, but the motifs (Ferris wheel, towers) are a human city.

packs.name: The DARK Series: Animal Pack 1
packs.size: Elk about 40 px tall, deer 28, rat 13, crow 10
covers: elk and deer: eat, walk, look, death
packs.notes: Near-black silhouettes with glowing cyan eyes and antlers, no outline: the closest thing to "dark, melancholy, cute-weird" in the whole search. The elk and deer read as big gentle grazers or haulers on fixed routes; rat and crow as scavengers; the orbs as glow motes.

scale.caption: Same zoom (3x): our gecko and small cap on the left, the pack at its native pixels on the right. Silhouettes at our grain.

packs.name: The DARK Series: A Strange Companion
covers: sleep, wake up, sniff and eat, bark
roll into a ball and roll
packs.notes: A shaggy burrowing scavenger that naps and curls into a rolling ball, at gecko size. Pairs with the Animal Pack. Could be a follower or a rideable animal.

scale.caption: Same zoom (3x): our gecko and small cap on the left, the pack at its native pixels on the right. About the gecko's size.

packs.name: Naked Mole Rat
covers: idle, move, dig, go underground, dig out
packs.notes: A burrower that competes with the gecko's tunnelling, or a tunnel worker the makers bred. Dark outline, soft pink, cute.

gaps.crystals: Not found: hand-pixelled crystals with a separate glow layer or light map, and copper veins drawn into side-view rock at a good level. Both look like commission work.
gaps.bg: Only codecrackers (pans on x and y) and Joe777 (a 320x576 shaft) are built for vertical scrolling; the climb needs tall or tiling layers. No pack shows derelict machinery without human cues (lit windows, runes, smoke), so a window vista is a commission or a repaint.
gaps.slimes: No pack has merge, glow or light-up-on-eat animations. Nearest pieces: split (Elthen Giant Slime), overlap (PixelPinion, sovietshnuckums), engulf (tienlev swallow), eat (World of Slimes), splatter (Lin_Ain).
gaps.insects: Nothing pairs glowing cave bugs with full side-view crawl animations on walls and ceilings. Closest: sovietshnuckums crystal bugs (tone), QuillGrafit and madameberry (glow), Redshrike (crawlers).
gaps.decor: Not found as good human-made art: steam vents, ambient dust or particle loops, drips and puddles (Fungi Mutation's spores aside). Commission (Pixelina, Hexany Ives) or generate them.

music.license: CC BY 4.0. Credit in the description or YouTube claims it (Smart Content ID).
music.notes: Katabasis (descent) and Anabasis (ascent) from The Weight of Air: slow dark low strings, on theme by name. Machina and Computations (no-cello mix) for machinery halls; Memories Of Stone ("deep time, ruins of a lost civilisation") for the ending. The YouTube link is Shadows and Dust.

music.title: Puzzle World (Loops)
music.license: Track pages say CC BY 4.0, album text says CC BY-ND: confirm in writing.
music.notes: Atmospheric electronics and crafted recordings, "dreamlike architecture, submerged memories": the best match for cute first, weird second. Titles: Subterranean Stairs, Fissure Break, Sunk In, Moss Underfoot, Where is Everybody. Released June 2026.
music.commission: Yes: josiebrechner.com/commissions, per-minute quote, FMOD/Wwise. Award-winning (Rift of the NecroDancer).

Shadowlands 3 "Machine" (part pipe organ, part broken pipe organ) and 5 "Antechamber" ("the alien machine that sustains our life is slowly breaking down").
